title: Needs you says All clear when it could not read anything at all
what: When the whole Needs you check fails (server down, a bad answer), HQ only writes a note to the browser's hidden console. The Needs you page then says All clear, nothing is waiting, and the menu number and tab title keep the last count, or show nothing if the first check failed. Nothing on screen says the list is out of date.
expected: When the check fails, Needs you says it could not be read just now and when it last worked, instead of All clear.
how_often: only when the needs check fails
fix_line: Remember that the last check failed and show a warning line instead of All clear
